description: This file provides a utility function 'formatLabel' to convert snake_case or underscored labels into a human-friendly Title Case format, primarily for display purposes in a frontend UI. It replaces underscores/spaces with a single space, capitalizes words, and handles common acronyms.

methods.name: formatLabel(key)
methods.description: Converts a snake_case or underscored label into Title Case with spaces, handling common acronyms and ensuring the original data remains unmutated.
